colors.name: Polar Night
colors.role: Primary dark. Headlines, dark backgrounds, the wordmark on light surfaces.

colors.name: Ice White
colors.role: Default light background for slides, documents and UI surfaces.

colors.name: Aurora Green
colors.role: The signature accent. One highlight per view: a key number, a call to action, a chart series.

colors.name: Fjord Blue
colors.role: Secondary brand color. Links, secondary buttons, second chart series.

colors.name: Slate
colors.role: Secondary text, borders, axis lines, captions.

colors.name: Ember
colors.role: Alerts and warnings only. Never decorative.

logo.clearSpace: At least the height of the letter N on every side.
rules: Use the SVG as is. Do not recolor, stretch, rotate or add effects.
Place the logo on Polar Night or Ice White only.
Never place the logo on photographs without a solid backing panel.
